from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
import unittest


PROJECT_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
PROGRAM = PROJECT_ROOT / "fingerprint.py"
TIMEOUT_SECONDS = 3


class FingerprintTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def run_program(self, *arguments: object) -> subprocess.CompletedProcess[bytes]:
        return subprocess.run(
            [sys.executable, str(PROGRAM), *(str(argument) for argument in arguments)],
            cwd=PROJECT_ROOT,
            stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL,
            stdout=subprocess.PIPE,
            stderr=subprocess.PIPE,
            check=False,
            timeout=TIMEOUT_SECONDS,
        )

    def run_in_workspace(
        self, workspace: Path, relative_path: object
    ) -> subprocess.CompletedProcess[bytes]:
        return self.run_program("--workspace", workspace, relative_path)

    def assert_failure(self, result: subprocess.CompletedProcess[bytes]) -> None:
        self.assertNotEqual(result.returncode, 0)
        self.assertEqual(result.stdout, b"")
        self.assertIn(b"error:", result.stderr)

    def assert_successful_fingerprint(self, data: bytes, expected_text: str) -> bytes:
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as temporary_directory:
            workspace = Path(temporary_directory)
            (workspace / "input.txt").write_bytes(data)
            result = self.run_in_workspace(workspace, "input.txt")

        expected_object = {
            "byte_count": len(data),
            "sha256": hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest(),
            "text": expected_text,
        }
        expected_output = (
            json.dumps(
                expected_object,
                ensure_ascii=False,
                sort_keys=True,
                separators=(",", ":"),
            ).encode("utf-8")
            + b"\n"
        )
        self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 0, result.stderr)
        self.assertEqual(result.stdout, expected_output)
        self.assertEqual(result.stderr, b"")
        return result.stdout

    def test_ascii_input_has_exact_canonical_output_and_digest(self) -> None:
        self.assert_successful_fingerprint(b"hello\n", "hello\n")

    def test_unicode_input_has_exact_canonical_output_and_byte_digest(self) -> None:
        text = "Snowman: \u2603; caf\u00e9; \U0001f642\n"
        self.assert_successful_fingerprint(text.encode("utf-8"), text)

    def test_empty_input_is_valid(self) -> None:
        self.assert_successful_fingerprint(b"", "")

    def test_exact_size_limit_is_valid(self) -> None:
        self.assert_successful_fingerprint(b"a" * 4096, "a" * 4096)

    def test_repeated_runs_are_byte_for_byte_identical(self) -> None:
        data = "repeat \u03bb\n".encode("utf-8")
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as temporary_directory:
            workspace = Path(temporary_directory)
            (workspace / "input.txt").write_bytes(data)
            first = self.run_in_workspace(workspace, "input.txt")
            second = self.run_in_workspace(workspace, "input.txt")

        self.assertEqual(first.returncode, 0, first.stderr)
        self.assertEqual(second.returncode, 0, second.stderr)
        self.assertEqual(first.stdout, second.stdout)
        self.assertEqual(first.stderr, second.stderr)

    def test_nested_regular_file_is_valid(self) -> None:
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as temporary_directory:
            workspace = Path(temporary_directory)
            (workspace / "one" / "two").mkdir(parents=True)
            (workspace / "one" / "two" / "input.txt").write_text(
                "nested", encoding="utf-8"
            )
            result = self.run_in_workspace(workspace, "one/two/input.txt")

        self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 0, result.stderr)
        self.assertEqual(json.loads(result.stdout), {
            "byte_count": 6,
            "sha256": hashlib.sha256(b"nested").hexdigest(),
            "text": "nested",
        })

    def test_missing_and_extra_arguments_fail_without_stdout(self) -> None:
        self.assert_failure(self.run_program())
        self.assert_failure(self.run_program("--workspace", "only-workspace"))
        self.assert_failure(self.run_program("wrong", "workspace", "input"))
        self.assert_failure(self.run_program("--workspace", "w", "i", "extra"))

    def test_missing_file_fails_without_stdout(self) -> None:
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as temporary_directory:
            result = self.run_in_workspace(Path(temporary_directory), "missing.txt")
        self.assert_failure(result)

    def test_invalid_utf8_fails_without_stdout(self) -> None:
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as temporary_directory:
            workspace = Path(temporary_directory)
            (workspace / "invalid.bin").write_bytes(b"valid prefix\xffinvalid")
            result = self.run_in_workspace(workspace, "invalid.bin")
        self.assert_failure(result)
        self.assertIn(b"not valid UTF-8", result.stderr)

    def test_oversized_input_fails_without_stdout(self) -> None:
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as temporary_directory:
            workspace = Path(temporary_directory)
            (workspace / "large.txt").write_bytes(b"a" * 4097)
            result = self.run_in_workspace(workspace, "large.txt")
        self.assert_failure(result)
        self.assertIn(b"exceeds 4096 bytes", result.stderr)

    def test_absolute_input_path_is_rejected(self) -> None:
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as temporary_directory:
            workspace = Path(temporary_directory)
            input_path = workspace / "input.txt"
            input_path.write_text("data", encoding="utf-8")
            result = self.run_in_workspace(workspace, input_path)
        self.assert_failure(result)

    def test_parent_traversal_is_rejected(self) -> None:
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as temporary_directory:
            parent = Path(temporary_directory)
            workspace = parent / "workspace"
            workspace.mkdir()
            (parent / "outside.txt").write_text("outside", encoding="utf-8")
            for path in ("../outside.txt", "sub/../../outside.txt"):
                with self.subTest(path=path):
                    self.assert_failure(self.run_in_workspace(workspace, path))

    def test_symlink_final_component_is_rejected(self) -> None:
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as temporary_directory:
            workspace = Path(temporary_directory)
            (workspace / "target.txt").write_text("target", encoding="utf-8")
            try:
                (workspace / "link.txt").symlink_to("target.txt")
            except (OSError, NotImplementedError) as error:
                self.skipTest(f"symlinks unavailable: {error}")
            result = self.run_in_workspace(workspace, "link.txt")
        self.assert_failure(result)

    def test_symlink_directory_component_is_rejected(self) -> None:
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as temporary_directory:
            workspace = Path(temporary_directory)
            real_directory = workspace / "real"
            real_directory.mkdir()
            (real_directory / "input.txt").write_text("target", encoding="utf-8")
            try:
                (workspace / "link").symlink_to("real", target_is_directory=True)
            except (OSError, NotImplementedError) as error:
                self.skipTest(f"symlinks unavailable: {error}")
            result = self.run_in_workspace(workspace, "link/input.txt")
        self.assert_failure(result)

    def test_directory_is_rejected(self) -> None:
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as temporary_directory:
            workspace = Path(temporary_directory)
            (workspace / "directory").mkdir()
            result = self.run_in_workspace(workspace, "directory")
        self.assert_failure(result)

    @unittest.skipUnless(hasattr(os, "mkfifo"), "FIFOs are unavailable")
    def test_fifo_is_rejected_without_blocking(self) -> None:
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as temporary_directory:
            workspace = Path(temporary_directory)
            os.mkfifo(workspace / "input.fifo")
            result = self.run_in_workspace(workspace, "input.fifo")
        self.assert_failure(result)

    def test_unreadable_regular_file_is_rejected_when_permissions_apply(self) -> None:
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as temporary_directory:
            workspace = Path(temporary_directory)
            input_path = workspace / "unreadable.txt"
            input_path.write_text("private fixture", encoding="utf-8")
            input_path.chmod(0)
            try:
                if os.access(input_path, os.R_OK):
                    self.skipTest("current user bypasses file permission bits")
                result = self.run_in_workspace(workspace, "unreadable.txt")
            finally:
                input_path.chmod(0o600)
        self.assert_failure(result)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
